$description: Mascot rig specification: the contract between Claude Design (draws layered SVG) and Claude Code (animates named layers, never redraws). Human guide: system/rig-spec.md. Validated by tools/check-rig.py.

canvas.units: rig units = SVG user units on the 1024 canvas
canvas.heightRule: mascot height (rig units) = persona.mascot.heightRatio x heightBasis, feet or base resting on groundY, horizontally centred on centreX

views.facing: three-quarter and side views face screen-right
views.rule: Every view of a mascot uses the identical id set, so one animation file drives any view.

rules: Lowercase ASCII only. Hierarchy separator is a double underscore; words inside a name use single hyphens; a state suffix uses a double hyphen.
Left/right are the mascot's own left/right, written -l and -r.
Every <g> and every <path> that is animated carries an id. Unanimated decoration may be anonymous but must sit inside a named group.
Ids are identical across views and across poses of the same mascot.

slots.$description: Top-level <g> elements, direct children of <svg>, in exactly this document order (back to front). Matches motion.layer-order in tokens.json, plus two rig-only slots.

notes.limbs-back: Far-side arm/leg in three-quarter and side views. Sits behind body. Not in the brief's layer order; added so turnarounds never need re-layering (Gate 1 decision).
notes.rig: Hidden anchor markers only (display="none"). Always last.

requiredParts.$description: Parts every mascot must provide. Path = slot/part[/subpart]. States listed must all exist as sibling groups; the first state is visible by default, others display="none".

lod.rule: Any group whose id ends in __detail is hidden in renders at or below 64px. Recognition features (silhouetteHook) must never live in __detail.
lod.minRecognitionStrokeNote: Rig units. 16 units = 1px at a 64px render (1024 / 64).

anchors.$description: Zero-size markers inside {mascot}__rig: <circle id="{mascot}__rig__{anchor}" cx cy r="0"/>. Code reads cx/cy as the transform-origin for the named part. Fixed anchors have mandatory coordinates in every view.

head-pivot.placement: base of the head / rim centre for vessel mascots

grip-l.drives: props held in the left hand

grip-r.drives: props held in the right hand (sachet by default)

look-at.placement: default gaze point, 400 units in front of the face

expressions.$description: Every mascot must reach these eight expressions purely by state swaps (no redraw). Values are lid / brow / mouth states.

svgRules: SVG 1.1 / 2 static, no <script>, no <foreignObject>, no embedded rasters (<image>), no external references.
No <text>: glyphs and lettering are outlined paths, except the empty brand-lockup slot rectangle (id {mascot}__foreground-type__lockup-slot) when present.
Groups may carry translate() only. No rotate/scale/skew/matrix baked into animatable groups; geometry is in final position.
Strokes stay strokes (stroke-width from persona shape.stroke). Do not expand outlines on animatable parts.
Fills and strokes use token colours only (exact hex from system/tokens/personas/*.tokens.json).
No clip-path or mask on animatable groups unless the mask itself has an id in the same slot.
One <svg> per view. Coordinates rounded to 0.5 rig units.

personaParts.$description: Persona-specific parts (from tokens persona.*.mascot.signatureProps plus motion needs). Each entry: slot/part[__subpart] -> states.

construction.$description: Front-view target proportions in rig units. Claude Design may deviate by canvas.tolerance (8%) without approval; larger changes come back to Gate review. Heights follow persona heightRatio x 768.

cram.hook: headphone band: arc radius 200, apex 60 above rim; fork: 220 tall, upright in grip-r

riot.baseShape: teardrop, point up, widest at 35% from base
riot.hook: flame crown: 3 points 160 / 220 / 140 tall, leaning 12 degrees right

nest.hook: apron bow: two 120-wide loops visible behind the dome at 60% height

sprig.baseShape: shallow bowl 440 x 220 with head dome above
sprig.hook: leaf pair on a 120 stem rising 280 above the head, leaves 140 x 70 at +/-35 degrees

lull.hook: crescent notch: circle of 0.6 head radius offset 0.35 radius up-right; 3 steam stars of 36 diameter

stack.baseShape: 3 stacked blocks: 420 x 220, 360 x 220, 300 x 200, left-aligned steps
stack.hook: price-tag flag 120 x 70 on a 60-unit string from the top-right corner

mise.baseShape: slim bowl 300 wide on a 140-wide foot
mise.hook: crossed chopsticks 520 long at 30 degrees, crossing 120 above the rim; noodle ribbon lifted 200

silhouetteTest.render: union of all slots except background, environment, foreground-type, rig and any __detail group, filled #000000
silhouetteTest.pass: Each of the seven is named correctly by a reviewer at a glance, and no two silhouettes overlap by more than 85% IoU after normalising to the same bounding-box height (computed at Gate 2).
